gen.title: Electoral college process from selection to inauguration
gen.orderNote: Steps follow the order presented in the source text

steps.label: Selection of electors outlined
steps.quote: the selection of the electors, the meeting of the electors where they vote for President and Vice President

steps.label: Voters choose candidate electors
steps.quote: When you vote for a Presidential candidate you are actually voting for your candidate's preferred electors.

steps.label: Electors meet in December
steps.quote: The meeting of the electors takes place on the first Tuesday after the second Wednesday in December after the general election.

steps.label: Electors cast votes on separate ballots
steps.quote: The electors meet in their respective States, where they cast their votes for President and Vice President on separate ballots.

steps.label: Congress counts electoral votes
steps.quote: Each State’s electoral votes are counted in a joint session of Congress on the 6th of January in the year following the meeting of the electors.
